compression_chain.meaning: 同一 trace key 与 named return 矩阵删除匿名 signed-field 缺口；生产性出口只能是新 primitive payload/trace。
新 payload 若不是 signed-lane 改名，必须携带 actual source-rank/no-collapse 包，第一原子为 source entropy。
沿 constructor source-entropy downstream 展开会回到 joint declaration；原回环被切掉，必须提交 fresh independent joint declaration。
row-level 表沿 signed-source 展开会固定点自证；删除固定点后只剩非循环 pre-Cauchy signed emission kernel。
strict kernel 的找行/容量部分由 LPF/Phi support stripping 支付；剩余是每个 `(p,m)` bucket 的 signed coefficient law。
source-rank 收敛支路把 trace/new-payload 出口汇入 alpha-row/source-rank 三原子。

external_rows.missing_interface: Prime Matrix strict rows have length P near x=P^2, i.e. x^(1/2)
external_rows.supplies: PNT in short intervals of length x^(17/30+o(1)) via zero-density estimates

external_rows.input: Le Duc Hieu short-interval APs of primes
external_rows.missing_interface: this transfers the same theta>17/30 threshold, still above the pointwise row scale x^(1/2)
external_rows.supplies: many k-term arithmetic progressions of primes in every interval [x,x+x^theta] once theta>17/30

external_rows.missing_interface: 0.52 remains above the required 1/2 row scale
external_rows.supplies: prime existence in intervals [x-x^0.52,x] for large x

external_rows.missing_interface: no ell-adic trace-function family has been constructed from the Prime Matrix source key
external_rows.supplies: bilinear trace-function bounds below Polya-Vinogradov under monodromy hypotheses

external_rows.missing_interface: no two-variable Kloosterman coefficient family is emitted by the current signed kernel
external_rows.supplies: power-saving bilinear Kloosterman bounds modulo arbitrary q

external_rows.missing_interface: no trilinear beta sequence or source-key convolution exists yet
external_rows.supplies: trilinear Kloosterman-fraction estimates for unbalanced convolution shapes

external_rows.missing_interface: current LPF buckets are unsigned and not well-factorable signed coefficients

frontier_rows.why: 这是 noncircular kernel 剥掉 LPF/Phi 无符号支撑容量后剩下的最小正向 signed coefficient law。

frontier_rows.requires: PhiLPFBucketSignedCoefficientLawBeforePushforward on all support keys without downstream recovery
frontier_rows.why: kernel 纪律仍是禁止回读 row-level 表、source-entropy payload 环或 Phi/payment 下游。

frontier_rows.requires: same formal-unit primitive alpha/delta kernel table
frontier_rows.why: trace/new-payload/source-rank 线在逐 primitive alpha/delta 核表上汇合。

frontier_rows.requires: complete signed values on fixed Phi-LPF support before pushforward
frontier_rows.why: 若直接给出逐点 signed table，就绕开 LPF 无符号奇偶障碍。

frontier_rows.requires: theta((kP,(k+1)P))>0 or psi(I)>PrimePowerTail(I) for every strict row
frontier_rows.why: 这是直接数素数的平方根行尺度输入。

frontier_rows.requires: same-set PDEC scope or source-keyed signed coefficient family suitable for dispersion/Kuznetsov
frontier_rows.why: 外部谱工具不能吃无符号 LPF support；必须先有 admissible signed family。

plain_conclusion: 本步把上一轮 atom-cut 前沿继续同步到真正非循环的 signed kernel 门。constructor edge signed fields 经过 same-trace/key return、new payload、source entropy 后会进入 payload/source-entropy 回环；row-level 表沿 signed-source 展开也会回到自身。strict kernel 再剥掉 LPF/Phi 无符号找行和容量后，内部最快主攻是 PhiLPFBucketSignedCoefficientLawBeforePushforward，并同时支付 signed survival 与 row-mass/no-heavy-row。并行可审稿路线是 alpha-row/source-rank 三原子、逐点 signed table、点态 theta/psi 平方根行输入或命名 PDEC/外部 source-keyed trace/Type-II family。
